purpose: One suggestion row in the InputTag dropdown: an existing option to add as a tag, or an action that creates a new one.

notFor.case: Standalone use outside the InputTag dropdown.
A row in a searchable picker of a known list.
An action row in a menu.

Default.visual: Surface/input fill; label and icon in Content/primary, meta in Content/subtle, badge dot in Status/success/content.

Focused.visual: Surface/muted fill with a Border/focus edge and Border/ring/default halo.

Disabled.visual: Action/disabled/default fill; label, meta, icon and badge in Content/disabled.

a11y.role: option, with aria-selected, inside a listbox
notes: The contract asks for a listbox with arrow-key navigation, but InputTag's authored keyboard covers only Enter, comma and Backspace.

openQuestions: Keyboard: which keys move through the suggestions (Arrow Up / Down?), which picks one (Enter?), and does focus stay in the text input (aria-activedescendant)?
Selected: what does an aria-selected option look like? The Figma set has no selected state.
Reduced motion: should the edge and halo transitions (use-hover, use-focus) be instant with reduced motion?
